title: Heavy Mace Datapack
description: This Datapack adds a powerful endgame weapon, crafted with one blaze rod, one heavy core, two nether stars, and a dragon egg.
body:
Heavy mace datapack, (& required resource pack) adds an endgame weapon with abilities such as right click to shoot into the air, hold spacebar to airdive and get velocity, and when you smash a mod with the mace, it yeets you back into the air.
It's crafted with One blaze rod, one heavy core, two nether stars, and a dragon egg.![This image shows the crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/20e44bfb8e411eb77b2f5a10724271c13b84c770.png)

Make sure you use the resource pack along with the datapack or it will result in a block with no textures.

Link to resource pack: https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/heavy-mace-resource-pack
